description.zh: 连接 Legado，在严格已读边界内陪聊、吐槽剧情、回顾前文，并维护章节摘要、人物事件索引和读者记忆。
description.en: Connects to Legado for spoiler-safe conversation, plot reactions, recall, chapter knowledge, and reader memories.

description.zh: 读取当前进度、回顾已读剧情、生成摘要、查询人物并保存读者笔记或预测。
description.en: Reads current progress, recalls read plot, builds summaries, finds characters, and stores reader notes or predictions.

description.zh: 预读且只预读下一章，一次生成真人式段评，并通过 Legado 原生段评入口按段落展示。开启即表示允许隔离生成器读取下一章。
description.en: Prefetches exactly one next chapter, generates reader-like paragraph comments in one request, and reveals them through Legado's native review UI.
